clauses.text: No person may carry a concealed handgun without a concealed carry permit issued by the county sheriff.
The sheriff shall issue a permit to an applicant who is 21 or older, may lawfully possess a handgun, and completes an eight-hour safety course.

current_law: A person 21 or older who may lawfully possess a handgun may carry it concealed without a permit.
